rationale: All 8 start runs are feasible with wide margins (hold +0.08 to +0.11 ns, 0 DRC, slew/cap pins far under the 953 bar), so only T_eff matters. Tighter targets generally gave better T_eff; the loose 17.5-18.4 ns runs ended near 10 ns. Every run still had positive slack, even at 9.12 ns. Pin the target at the floor, 0.45 (8.49 ns), just under the best T_eff of 8.574, so results land near their target and hold up on re-runs. The three cap213 runs averaged about 8.95 ns versus 9.6 (orfs) and 10.1 (stock); the two best also ran post-GRT timing repair, and the best used DELAY 4. Pin those and let TPE tune the rest.
